title: NvM - Break It Down
htmlContent:
Multi-talented rapper and songwriter NvM was born and raised in the Midlands, where he developed his craft and love for music. NvM is no stranger to the streets. The UK Drill NvM has unveiled his new single "Break It Down." 

Although NvM is serving five years in prison, he is determined to drop new music and organize simultaneous music videos from his jail cell. NvM gets into tune with "Break It Down" bravado and unapologetic lyrics that aim at the contenders and skeptics.

NvM "Break It Down" is available on all streaming platforms.
